Package io.jans.lock.model.trace.api

Class TraceBulkResultEntry

java.lang.Object
io.jans.lock.model.trace.api.TraceBulkResultEntry
public class TraceBulkResultEntry extends Object
One element of POST /audit/trace/bulk's results array (design §11.2): the submitted array's position and whether that item was accepted. An accepted entry carries the single-record acceptance members inline (producer_id ... late_flag); a rejected entry carries getError() plus producer_id/record_id when they were readable from the element. Members that do not apply to the entry's outcome are omitted.
Author:
Yuriy Movchan
